resolved_or_reduced: OSID is persistent but only unique within a feature type and the same OSID may occur across feature types representing the same geographical feature
TOID is optional on most OS NGD features and should not be relied on for linking or change-only update processing
Royal Mail Address uses UDPRN as its primary identifier and can contain a nullable matched UPRN
Royal Mail to Local Authority match types distinguish Direct from Parent Neighbour and Street estimated relationships
A non-Direct Royal Mail match is positional or representative context and not exact property ownership or building evidence
OS NGD Site matcheduprn is nullable when no address can be identified unambiguously
Site address classification is omitted when contained addresses have differing primary-level classifications
Site extentdefinition records confidence in the quality of site geometry and must be retained with the geometry
Site geometry and matched UPRN are land-use context rather than legal parcel or title evidence
HMLR National Polygon contains acceptable technical actual and minor overlap conditions
Overlaps may be legitimate because of floor levels strata tenure or class of title
Minor polygon overlaps below 0.5 square metres are not referred for remedial action
Index polygons can be footprint artificial footprint exaggerated extent gridded or former-practice coextensive leasehold representations
Index polygons are indicative and may be larger or smaller than the title-plan extent
Daily OS MasterMap change-only updates are used for creation of new index polygons and title plans but do not routinely update existing registrations
Existing index polygons are normally changed only through title activity customer query adjoining registration or detected error
BDUK sample rows 809 through 983 were revalidated as the final 175 exact UPRN records in the official web preview
